short_description: Trade short rhythms between two players, then reproduce the full pulse sequence by tapping.
description: Trade short rhythms between two players, then reproduce the full pulse sequence by tapping. The composer taps the wheel button at least three times to set a phrase. Start hands it to the second player. Tap the rhythm from memory; intervals must be within 25% or 120 ms. On a successful echo, pass back and add a beat to the phrase. Hold Start starts a new round. A phrase can contain up to twelve taps.
changelog: New screen transitions and high-contrast LED previews.
